rationale: F18 (2026-10-31): what a `provide()` publishes is not only its `key: value` pairs. Vue hands the injector whatever object the call was given, so a SHORTHAND (which shares a local), a SHORTHAND METHOD, and an object WRAPPED in `reactive()`/`computed()` all name members a consumer reads. The old walk required the direct second argument to be an `object` and accepted only `pair` children, so it published the pairs and dropped the rest — dropdown.vue lost contentRef / triggerId / isUsingKeyboard / onItemEnter / onItemLeave / handleClose, and form.vue lost every member of its `reactive({ ... })` including emit / resetFields / clearValidate / validateField. Measured: 12 real provided rows the `contains` oracle derived and the analyzer never emitted. A provided member with no symbol of its own is now SYNTHESIZED with `metadata.synthesized`, the same declaration the stem fallback uses, so the m60 surface audit still governs it.
